game.blurb: Turn-based RPG set in Honolulu and Yokohama, from Ryu ga Gotoku Studio, released 2024-01-26. RAWG average playtime: 51 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2072450)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Like_a_Dragon:_Infinite_Wealth
Fandom (yakuza.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://yakuza.fandom.com/wiki/Like_a_Dragon:_Infinite_Wealth
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); it links Walkthrough, Substories, Minigames, Gameplay, Controls and Achievements subpages, but only "Table of Contents" (about 600 characters) exists, so nothing was used. yakuza.fandom.com answers the API with about 95 linked articles, including chapter pages "Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth/Chapter 1" to "Chapter 13" plus "Finale", "Substories", "Sujimon", "Honolulu" and "Crazy Delivery"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "ELVIS" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2072450. 23 of 74 Steam achievements are hidden; all sit in the main story chapter. The first 14 hidden ones (from "Back in Action" to "The Man Who Regained His Name") fall steadily in unlock rate and read like story chapters; the next 7 ("No Regrets" to "Commanding Respect", 30 to 57%) and "Not a Total Waste" and "Somewhere Over the Rainbow" may be side content, but the data does not say. The Big Swell (five sectors, about 10 to 12% unlock rates) has its own chapter; the data does not say whether it is post-game or add-on content.
